source.sqlReaderQuery:
select 
City_Cd_Src,
City_NmEn_Src,
City_NmCn_Src,
City_Cd,
City_NmEn,
City_NmCn,
CityGrp_Cd,
CityGrp_NmCn,
CityGrp_NmEn,
CityGrp_M_Cd,
CityGrp_M_NmCn,
CityGrp_M_NmEn,
DSO_Cd,
DSO_NmCn,
DSO_NmEn,
SubRegion_Cd,
SubRegion_NmCn,
SubRegion_NmEn,
Region_Cd,
Region_NmCn,
Region_NmEn,
Business_Geo_Src,
Start_Dt,
End_Dt,
GETDATE() Etl_Tm
from
[NESZ_DIM].[MAP_EcmsCity_DSCC_Geo]

SELECT
T1.PRD_UNIID,
T1.SRC_PRD_CD,
T1.SRC_PRD_CD_DES,
T1.SRC_SYS_NM,
T1.SRC_SYS_CD,
T1.SRC_SYS_CD_DES,
T1.STA_DT,
T1.END_DT,
DATEADD(HH,8,getdate())
 FROM [MVIEW].[MDM_LKGPRD_MST_MAPPING] T1

SELECT
T1.PRD_UNIID,
T1.SRC_PRD_CD,
T1.SRC_PRD_CD_DES,
T1.SRC_SYS_NM,
T1.SRC_SYS_CD,
T1.SRC_SYS_CD_DES,
T1.STA_DT,
T1.END_DT,
DATEADD(HH,8,getdate())
 FROM [MVIEW].[MDM_LKGPRD_MST_MAPPING] T1

select
SkuGrp_Version,
Product_Cd,
SkuGrp_Cd,
SkuGrp_NmEn,
SkuGrp_NmCn,
SkuGrp_Segment1,
SkuGrp_Segment2,
Is_SkuGrp_Active,
SkuGrp_Cluster,
Etl_Tm
from
NESZ_DIM.MAP_Sku_Grp

select 
City_Cd,
City_NmEn,
City_NmCn,
Region_Cd,
Region_NmCn,
Region_NmEn,
GETDATE() Etl_Tm
from
[NESZ_DIM].[MAP_StandardCity_Region]

select 
	ACC_CD,
	ACC_INM_CN,
	ACC_INM_EN,
	ACC_DNM_CN,
	ACC_DNM_EN,
	ACC_TYP_CD,
	ACC_TYP_INM_CN,
	ACC_TYP_INM_EN,
	ACC_TYP_DNM_CN,
	ACC_TYP_DNM_EN,
	STA_DT,
	END_DT
from MVIEW.MDM_ACC_MST_MV

select 
	BRD_CD,
	BRD_DES_EN,
	BRD_DES_CN,
	BRD_SHR_DES_EN,
	BRD_SHR_DES_CN,
	BRD_GRP,
	BRD_STA_DT,
	BRD_END_DT
from MVIEW.MDM_BRD_MV

select
CST_SAL_ORG,
REF_CMP_NAM_CN,
REF_CMP_NAM_EN,
CST_DST_CHL_ID,
REF_CHL_DES_CN,
REF_CHL_DES,
CST_CLS_GRP,
CST_UNIID,
CST_NO,
CST_NAM_CN,
CST_NAM_EN,
CONVERT(date,CST_STA_DT,23),
CONVERT(date,CST_END_DT,23)
from MVIEW.MDM_CSTL4_CLS_GRP_MV

select
CST_SAL_ORG,
REF_CMP_NAM_CN,
REF_CMP_NAM_EN,
CST_DST_CHL_ID,
REF_CHL_DES_CN,
REF_CHL_DES,
CST_CLS_GRP,
CST_UNIID,
CST_NO,
CST_NAM_CN,
CST_NAM_EN,
CONVERT(date,CST_STA_DT,23),
CONVERT(date,CST_END_DT,23)
from MVIEW.MDM_CSTL4_CLS_GRP_MV
